verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships programmatic surfaces for its core function: an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server via `edge0 serve`, a transformers-style Python API (`AutoEngine.from_pretrained`), and CLI flags such as --no-lora, --no-prerouter and --show-thinking. It also ships desktop and mobile apps, but nothing documents that the API covers everything those UIs can do. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documentation of what the apps expose versus the API, API coverage of model download and adapter management, and independent hands-on corroboration.
